48.original: Triple Triad is taking Eorzea by storm! Care to try your hand at this entrancing new card game?

49.original: Try your hand at Triple Triad?

52.original: Are you sure? It's easy to begin, and challenging to master! Well, another time, perhaps!

53.original: And so another challenger is born! Welcome to the world of Triple Triad, where you pit your cards against an opponent's in a tense battle of skill, strategy...and the odd dose of luck!

54.original: Here at the Manderville Gold Saucer, I am pleased to present all new players with the cards they need to get started!

55.original: To play a match, however, first you'll need to build a deck composed of five cards from your registered card list.

56.original: Oh, and I suggest speaking with the nearby Triple Triad trader should you wish to expand your card collection!

57.original: You can now play Triple Triad.

58.original: You are now able to challenge opponents to Triple Triad matches. New cards can be obtained from a number of sources, including the Triple Triad trader, victory spoils from winning matches, and prizes from Triple Triad tournaments.

59.original: Play against the Triple Triad master to learn the basic rules of the game. Before you can begin, however, there are several steps that must be completed.

60.original: First, you must <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Use<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> the cards in your inventory to register them to your <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Card List<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. Your card list can be viewed via the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Gold Saucer<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> options found under <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Character<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> in the main menu.

61.original: Next, access your <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Card Decks<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, also located within the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Gold Saucer<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> options, and build a deck by selecting five cards from those you have registered.

62.original: Speak with the Triple Triad master once your deck is ready, and she will engage you in a tutorial match.
